settings.title: Settings
settings.autoNightBody: From 7:30 pm to 7 am, routes favour lit streets and the map turns dark.
settings.vibrationBody: One pulse for a turn, two for a hazard ahead, one long pulse on arrival.
settings.demoBody: For the class demo. Guests can report and vote while the Langkah server allows it.
settings.newGuestDone: You are now a different guest, so you can confirm your own earlier report.
settings.privacyLocation: Location is used on the phone to show where you are and to guide a walk. Langkah never keeps a history of where you walked.
settings.privacyReports: Reports are anonymous unless you turn that off. Then only your first name from Google is shown. Your email is never shown.
settings.privacyPhotos: Photos are shrunk on the phone before upload, which also removes the GPS and camera details inside them.
settings.privacyRatings: Walk ratings send only the rating, day or night, the route's score and its length. No places.

welcome.pitch: Langkah finds the safest walking route and warns you about hazards on the way. For that it needs your location.
welcome.reasonRoute: Plan walks from where you are
welcome.reasonHazard: Warn you about hazards ahead while you walk
welcome.reasonReport: Pin a report where you stand
welcome.privacy: Location stays on your phone. Langkah never keeps a history of where you walked.

batteryTip.title: Keep your walk running
batteryTip.body: This phone may stop apps in the background to save battery. Then Langkah cannot follow your walk with the screen off.
batteryTip.steps: In Settings, open Battery (or App launch) for Langkah and allow it to run in the background.
